fields.summary: Add JWT-based authentication to the REST API
fields.description:
Users need to authenticate with the API using JWT tokens. Currently all endpoints are public. We need to secure them with bearer token authentication.

Acceptance Criteria:
- AC-1: /api/login endpoint accepts email + password and returns a signed JWT
- AC-2: Protected endpoints return 401 if no valid token is provided
- AC-3: Token expires after 24 hours
- AC-4: Passwords must be hashed using bcrypt before storage
- AC-5: Unit tests must achieve ≥ 80% coverage on auth module

fields.summary: Pagination returns duplicate items on page boundary
fields.description:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Create 20 items in the database
2. Fetch page 1 with page_size=10 — returns items 1-10
3. Fetch page 2 with page_size=10 — returns items 10-19 (item 10 duplicated)

Expected: Page 2 returns items 11-20
Actual: Page 2 returns items 10-19

Acceptance Criteria:
- AC-1: Page 2 must not contain any items from page 1
- AC-2: All 20 items are returned across 2 pages with no duplicates
- AC-3: Edge case: page_size=1 returns exactly 1 unique item per page

fields.summary: Replace deprecated _.flatten and _.pluck with native JS equivalents
fields.description:
Technical debt cleanup. Lodash 4.x removed _.pluck. We should replace all lodash calls in src/utils/ with native Array methods.

Acceptance Criteria:
- AC-1: No imports of lodash remain in src/utils/
- AC-2: All tests in tests/utils/ continue to pass
- AC-3: ESLint reports zero new errors
- AC-4: Bundle size decreases by ≥ 5kb after tree-shaking
